_status: PROVISIONAL — source reel: NDCH_017_FRICTION. Do not treat as universal law until tested across at least 3 reels.
_law: This preset is the default starting position. Override only if the doctrine's emotional temperature requires it. Document the override and the reason.
description: Audio mastering chain derived from NDCH_017. Defines the full technical stack from raw TTS to final MP4: VO processing, music hierarchy, final mix normalization, ending decay, and limiter settings. Every future reel inherits this as its default. 018 runs with this preset unless the doctrine requires a different emotional temperature.

stage_1_vo_processing.description: EQ + loudness normalization applied to the breathed VO before music mixing.

low_shelf.purpose: Body and warmth. Narration should have physical presence, not phone-call thinness.

presence_boost.purpose: Intelligibility. Consonants and articulation carry doctrine — they must be audible.

loudness_normalization.purpose: VO reference level. Music ducking ratios and final mix level are relative to this.

stage_2_music_hierarchy.description: Music level rules relative to the VO reference. Levels are derived from the cinematic hierarchy, not from listening.

narration_sections.purpose: Sub-perceptual. Music marks presence only. Cognitive load belongs to the voice.

breathing_pause_sections.music_db_relative_to_narration: +6 to +8 dB above narration music level
breathing_pause_sections.purpose: Ambient rise. Music fills the cognitive space the voice just vacated.

pivot_dwell.purpose: Primary rise event. Doctrine has landed. Music holds the space for processing.

visual_tail.purpose: Music owns the frame. Voice has exited. Highest music prominence in the reel.

stage_3_final_mix._maps_to: The remix step in assemble-audio.ts (future: integrate into mixMusicUnderVO)
stage_3_final_mix.description: Applied to the combined VO+music mix after mixing. This is the mastering chain that produces the deliverable.

vo_level_adjustment.purpose: Shifts VO from 'on top of' to 'integrated into' the environment. Retains authority without straining.
vo_level_adjustment.note: This is a taste-sensitive range. The ±0.5 dB tolerance is real. Document changes.

true_peak_ceiling.purpose: Headroom for inter-sample peaks in streaming delivery.

lra.purpose: Natural dynamic range. Doctrine should breathe — not compressed flat.

ending_decay.description: The Möbius close. Music recedes as the doctrine settles.
ending_decay.purpose: Viewer exits into silence, not into music. The doctrine ends — the music confirms it.
ending_decay.law: The final dissolve region must always end at music_volume_db <= -42. Never let the reel end while music is audible.

compression.approach: loudnorm handles dynamic range management via integrated loudness normalization. No additional compression compressor required at this time.
compression.note: If a future doctrine requires dramatic dynamic contrast (e.g., silence followed by sudden impact), revisit with a dedicated compressor stage.

override_protocol.when_to_override: When the doctrine's emotional temperature is demonstrably different from 'cold, restrained, inevitable.' Example: a doctrine about urgency or rupture may require different VO level, music hierarchy, or LRA.
override_protocol.how_to_override: Create a new preset file in assets/mastering/ with a new preset_id. Reference it in sound_direction.mastering_preset_id in script.json. Document the delta from this preset and the doctrinal reason.
override_protocol.do_not: Do not modify this file to accommodate a single reel. Override, don't mutate the default.

promotion_status.promotion_condition: The preset produces an approved production master on 018 and 019 without requiring the override protocol. If both reels complete without overrides, the preset is a stable default.
promotion_status.018_instruction: Inherit this preset. Run without modification. Report any point where the doctrine demands a different chain.
